- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER generated £3.4k revenue TW, the highest performing product, with 1,258 units sold across 62 orders.
- PACK OF 12 SUKI TISSUES achieved £2.6k revenue TW with 5,247 units sold, demonstrating strong volume performance.
- PACK OF 12 HEARTS DESIGN TISSUES generated £2.5k revenue TW from 5,007 units, showing consistent demand alongside SUKI TISSUES.
- Total revenue reached £64.7k TW, representing a 41.5% WoW increase from £45.7k LW.
- SOMBRERO experienced exceptional growth with revenue up 51,182.1% WoW, indicating a significant surge in demand.
- PACK OF 12 HEARTS DESIGN TISSUES revenue increased 6,087.6% WoW, while PACK OF 12 SUKI TISSUES grew 5,937.3% WoW.
- Total units sold TW reached 35,010 across all products, driven by high-volume tissue product sales.
- WOODEN SKITTLES GARDEN SET and WOODEN CROQUET GARDEN SET contributed £2.7k and £2.2k revenue respectively TW, representing the strongest garden product performers.
